items.title: Custody’s next chapter: State Street’s Ambrosius on AI, tokenisation and the race for scale
items.summary: Global Custodian’s Chris Lemmon sits down with Jörg Ambrosius, president of State Street Investment Services, to discuss how technology is reshaping custody and administration – and the risks that come with it.

items.title: BNY expands digital asset custody for Ripple
items.summary: Expanded relationship adds XRP and RLUSD to BNY’s custody platform, as the firms explore tokenised trade finance and other institutional uses for blockchain.

items.title: Standard Chartered to integrate Zodia Custody into existing digital asset custody activities
items.summary: The deal will bring Zodia Custody’s regulated digital asset custody operations into Standard Chartered’s securities services business, while its software and professional services arm will be spun out into a separate entity.

items.title: Senior HSBC digital assets executive to exit role
items.summary: Executive to leave role after more than two years at HSBC, having previously spent nearly a decade at State Street working across digital asset strategy and product development.

items.title: BNY expands digital asset custody platform in Europe
items.summary: The move follows the addition of BNY’s European banking entity to the EU’s MiCA register in July.

items.title: Standard Chartered expands digital asset custody into Singapore
items.summary: The bank plans to offer custody for selected crypto assets, stablecoins and tokenised real-world assets, adding Singapore to its growing network of digital asset custody markets.

items.title: Euroclear loses global digital assets lead to Apex Group
items.summary: Executive departs after helping build Euroclear's digital assets practice and launch its first digital market infrastructure.

items.title: Fireside Friday with… Transcend’s Bimal Kadikar
items.summary: Bimal Kadikar, founder & CEO of Transcend, discusses the firm’s recent Series B investment with 7RIDGE, its expansion into collateral, liquidity and tokenised markets, and how it is building infrastructure to bridge traditional and digital financial ecosystems through optimisation, interoperability and AI-driven…

items.title: Zodia Custody to support Australian dollar stablecoin AUDM
items.summary: The digital assets custodian, backed by Standard Chartered and Northern Trust, adds support for Macropod’s Australian dollar-backed stablecoin, giving institutional clients secure access to the token for payments and settlement use cases.
